UI_WindSway_JavaMissingDescription: Wind Sway's Java part did not load (ZombieBuddy prompt declined?). Options below have no effect.
UI_WindSway_EnableTooltip: Master switch: turns on the game's wind path and draws swaying vegetation with the mod's batched renderer. Off = back to your vanilla settings.
UI_WindSway_WindPresetTooltip: The mod's own wind while the game's weather is idle. Vanilla = the game's wind only. Custom uses the two sliders below.
UI_WindSway_WindFloorTooltip: Only with Custom. Both sliders 0 = vanilla wind.
UI_WindSway_WindCeilTooltip: Only with Custom. At or below the minimum: a steady wind at the minimum.
UI_WindSway_WeatherTakeoverTooltip: During rain, fog and storms the game's wind rules, even below your wind band. Off: the band stays as a floor, weather only shows above it. No effect on Vanilla.
UI_WindSway_WindSoundTooltip: The wind ambience follows the mod's wind. Sound only, gameplay untouched.
UI_WindSway_WindSoundLevelTooltip: How much of the mod's wind the ambience hears. At the default the wind bed stays near vanilla; raise it if you play Windy or Custom and want to hear it. Weather sounds stay as they are.
UI_WindSway_TreeDetailTooltip: Lower levels drop the fine branch and leaf motion, the crown still bends.
